data.content_ref: inline:The abstraction claim is undercut by its own refutation condition. If market signal synchronization can induce correlated failures through self-organized criticality — a dynamical mechanism distinct from selection-pressure monoculture — then SRC_002 does not cleanly abstract SRC_005, because SRC_005 possesses an explanatory pathway the abstraction cannot predict. A genuine abstraction must preserve/explain the instances' behavior; admitting a mechanism specific to SRC_005 outside the abstraction's scope means the abstraction is partial, not the generalization claimed. The target concedes this yet still asserts SRC_002 abstracts SRC_005 without qualification.
